body:
发现分诊轮判级(#4949 纪律):**持有**(`finding` 留)。

**为什么还留着**:方向上没有疑问 —— 授权侧事实拼写是 `label`(仓内 5 个真实 section 全写 `label`,objectui 类型镜像与 Studio 区块设计器也只产出 `label`),唯一写 `title` 的是一个**合成测试夹具**;#5611 的 PR 已按 PD #12 只声明 `label`、不把消费方容忍写进契约。剩下的是清掉三处 `title ?? label` 容忍读法,**但它跨三个车道**:objectui 渲染器(`repo:objectui`)、`packages/cli` 的 i18n 抽取(`domain:cli`)、`packages/lint`(`domain:devx`)。为一个零用户影响的清理做 contract-first 拆分(父单 + 三个 sub-issue + `Blocked-by:`),拆分成本明显大于收益。

**重启条件**:① 上述任一车道的 PM 下次因别的单动到这三个文件时**顺带收**(本评论即为那时的依据,三处位置已逐一锚定:`plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-details.tsx:193`、`packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts:401`、`packages/lint/src/validate-translatable-sections.ts:329`,外加合成夹具 `packages/cli/test/i18n-section-coverage.test.ts:220`);或 ② `title` 拼写**首次出现在真实授权面**(而非测试夹具)时立即晋级 —— 那意味着容忍读法已经开始生产第二套方言,正是 PD #12 要防的东西。


本评论来自分诊座位 Routine(#5474 试点),不构成认领。

**Findings triage — re-check of the least-recently-reviewed hold. Verdict: HOLD stands (`finding` kept). Both restart cells re-verified as NOT triggered.**

**Reading method matters here.** The natural check ("has anyone touched those three files since 08-06?") was attempted with `git log --since` and **discarded**: this checkout is shallow, and the log returns the same single boundary commit for every path — the false-reading shape Operational note 6 warns about. The reliable check is **presence of the code itself** on `origin/main`, which is what is recorded below.

**Cell ① — "a lane collects it while passing through": not triggered.** All three tolerance reads are still present verbatim at their anchored positions:

- `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts:401` — `addSection(index, objectName, s.name, s.label ?? s.title);`
- `packages/lint/src/validate-translatable-sections.ts:329` — `const heading = strName(section.label) ?? strName(section.title);`
- `packages/cli/test/i18n-section-coverage.test.ts:220` — the synthetic fixture still authors `{ name: 'timeline', title: 'Timeline', ... }`.

**Cell ② — "`title` appears on a real authoring surface": not triggered, and the evidence got stronger.** Every `record:details` `sections:` array on `origin/main` was re-read: `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/pages/project-detail.page.ts` (3), `settings.page.ts` (2), `task-detail.page.ts` (3), `packages/platform-objects/src/pages/sys-user.page.ts` (4). **All ~12 section entries write `label`; zero write `title`.** ⚠️ Note the issue body's figure of "5 real sections" is now stale — the authoring surface roughly doubled since filing and *still* produced no `title`. That cuts in favour of holding: the tolerant reads are not, in practice, breeding the second dialect PD #12 warns about — which is precisely what cell ② was written to detect.

One false-positive trap for whoever checks this next: a bare `title:` grep over `*.page.ts` hits plenty of lines (`page:header` titles, related-list titles, `sys-user.page.ts:160/:200`). Those are **different properties**. Cell ② is only about `title` **inside a `record:details` `sections[]` entry** — check the enclosing array, not the keyword.

Hold reason unchanged: the cleanup spans three lanes (`repo:objectui` renderer, `domain:cli` extractor, `domain:devx` lint) for zero user impact today, so a contract-first split costs more than it returns. Restart conditions carry forward verbatim.

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine(#5474 试点),不构成认领。
